system.description:
Protects against magic of all kinds: an instant gesture for yourself, or a 30-minute ritual that wards others.

Spell. The Warding Gesture: Routine (6) Incidental 1/–1, Formidable (12) Apprentice 2/–1, Very Hard (18) Basic 3/–2, Heroic (24) Standard 4/–3. A gesture wards you for one minute; you may choose a weaker ward to limit the penalty on your own casting.

Ritual. Alignment: Challenging (9) Cunning, 10 minutes applying salts, oils and powders. Invocation: Challenging (9) Knowledge, 20 minutes. Unleashing: Formidable (12) or higher Will; the result sets the ward's strength.

Art of Warding — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 104.
system.resonances: None (spell), or protective salts and oils (35 silver drachmas, ritual).
